name: This Place Will Become Your Tomb
name_with_artist: This Place Will Become Your Tomb (artist: Sleep Token)
description_preview:
This Place Will Become Your Tomb (from now on referred to as TPWBYT) is the sophomore studio album from the anonymous collective known as Sleep Token, released 24th of September, 2021.

Following the success of their debut album, Sundowning, TPWBYT expands the lore of the universe behind Sleep Token’s imagery, leading the cult following of Vessel through mania and depression, navigating the obsessive relationships that their debut sets out.
